process.commandLine: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$client = [Net.Sockets.TcpClient]::new(); try { $connected = $client.ConnectAsync('1.1.1.1', 443).Wait(5000) } catch { $connected = $false } finally { $client.Dispose() }; if ($connected) { Write-Output 'OK:allow_port_range_tcp443'; exit 0 }; Write-Output 'FAIL:allow_port_range_tcp443_blocked'; exit 1"
